comment: The pinned Shopper Mind run (v3.12-draft) — the run whose frozen capture backs the 05 Mind page forever. Nisolo's five real image ads over a social-enabled population: same calibration recipe as social-graph-demo (w_social 0.5 so the P1 trust layer is paid for, stage_bases.CLICK 2 so the funnel is a funnel, fulfillment.lag_ticks 1 so BOUGHT->EXPERIENCED pairs land inside the window), but the WORLD is fixtures/nisolo — brand 6100, creatives 2000101-2000105, the committed perception cache reading the actual campaign images. 100 shoppers x 28 ticks gives find_social_triads real choice and the day range depth. t0 1832000000 is a fresh PRICED_AT window (v3.4-draft: pricing is global objective state read as-of t, experiments must not share one; social-graph-demo ends ~1812.4M). Export with `python -m shopsim.runner export-graph ... --previews` into fixtures/shopper-mind/ — see the README there.
